author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Rolls this stream's followers, subscribers, gifters, supporters, raiders and moderators from every platform as scrolling end credits.
changelog: 4.1.89: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.89, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.64: initial release with per-stream name lists, scrolling credits overlay, auto-roll on scene show, and a moderator !credits command.

manifest.name: End Credits
installationSteps: Install and enable End Credits. No separate Streamer.bot import or direct trigger is required.
Choose the sections, wording and style in the wizard.
Add the browser-source URL to your ending scene at 1920 x 1080. The credits roll each time that scene is shown.
Moderators can also type !credits to roll them, or !credits reset to start a fresh list.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. The current list stays saved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that each stream’s name lists stay within their limits and reach the End Credits overlay.
